simple.meaning: אֶלְעָזָר (ʼElʻâzâr) appears 72 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with priesthood. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering from the firstborn of the flock and its fat. The surrounding account also brings the name into conflict.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 6 more, beginning at Exodus 6:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, offering, firstborn, altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶלְעָזָר (H499) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אֶלְעָזָר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Elazar , the name of seven Israelites
definitions.full: H499. Elazar אֶלְעָזָר proper name, masculine ( God has helped , compare אֱלִיעֶזֶר above) a. Eleazar the priest Exod 6:23 + (50 t. in Hexateuch) Judg 20:28 ; 1 Chronicles 5:29, 30; 1Chr 6:35 ; 9:20 ; 24:1-2 , 3 , 4 (twice in verse); 24:5-6 , Ezra 7.. b. son of Abinadab 1Sam 7:1 . c. one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:9 ; 1Chr 11:12 ; insert also 27:4 compare Dr Sm 280. d. a Levite 1Chr 23:21-22 , 24:28 . e. priest of the time of Ezra Ezra 8:33 ; Neh 12:42 . feminine one of the line of Parosh Ezra 10:25 .
